operating_income.source: NIKE does not report operating income; used EBIT (earnings before interest and taxes) per 10-K: FY2024 6,539, FY2025 3,778 (FY2025 10-K acc. 0000320187-25-000047). FY2026 = pre-tax income 3,900 less net interest income 50 (Q4 FY26 press release tables / 10-K FY2026) = 3,850, derived

d_and_a.source: FY2024 and FY2025: cash flow statement in NIKE FY2025 annual report (acc. 0001308179-25-000564). FY2026 747: third-party aggregator (stockanalysis.com NKE cash-flow page), not verified against the 10-K

capex.source: Additions to PP&E per cash flow statement, FY2025 annual report: FY2024 812, FY2025 430. FY2026 not found (search limit reached); FY2026 investing cash flow was -488 total per 10-K but capex split not retrieved

revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: Q1 FY2027 revenue was down 4% reported (10-Q Aug 2026, acc. 0000320187-26-000193), so FY2027 slightly negative; gradual turnaround recovery in FY2028-FY2030 and fade toward mid-single digit growth by FY2031. FY2026 was flat vs FY2025.

ebit_margin.source: Analyst assumption: FY2026 EBIT margin 8.3% (3,850/46,398), FY2025 8.2%, FY2024 12.7%. Assume 9% as partial recovery from trough, below the FY2024 level due to tariffs and wholesale mix. Single flat margin.

tax_rate.source: FY2026 effective rate about 20.3% (income tax 792 / pre-tax income 3,900), FY2025 17.1% (666/3,885); assume 20%

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2024 1.6% (812/51,362), FY2025 0.9% (430/46,309); FY2026 capex not found. 1.5% assumed, roughly in line with D&A.

wacc.source: Analyst assumption: large-cap consumer brand, beta about 1.0-1.1, risk-free about 4.2%, ERP about 5%, A+/A1 rated and low leverage, so cost of equity approximately equals WACC at about 8.5%. Not from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Analyst assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation, below WACC; brand with global growth runway

net_debt.source: Not found: search limit reached before retrieving the May 31, 2026 balance sheet. Partial data: total debt about 7,942 (current portion 2,000 + long-term 5,942, per third-party debt analysis page); cash about 7,563 derived from FY2025 cash 7,464 + FY2026 net cash increase 99; short-term investments for FY2026 not found. Reviewer must complete.

diluted_shares.source: Approximate, derived: FY2026 net income 3,108 / diluted EPS 2.10 (Q4 FY26 press release tables) is about 1,480 million. Not taken from the filing; consistent with Q1 FY27 diluted 1,484.2 and Q1 FY26 1,479.0. Replace with the 10-K weighted average diluted figure.
